component.name: MarkdownMate
component.summary: Write notes as plain Markdown files in your own folders

description.p: MarkdownMate is a native, local-first Markdown notes app. Open any folder and your notes are just .md files in it: no account, no cloud, no telemetry. Everything is saved automatically and never overwrites changes made by another app.

ul.li: Folder sidebar that follows changes on disk, with new note, folder, rename and move to Trash
Edit, Preview and Side by side modes with synced scrolling and highlighted code
Math formulas and Mermaid diagrams in the preview, fully offline
Open Quickly by name and Find in Folder across all notes
Wiki links, tags, outline and autocompletion for links and tags
Smart lists, to-do checkboxes and bold, italic and link shortcuts
Paste or drop images straight into a note
Default, Paper, Graphite and Solarized themes in light and dark
Export as HTML, Copy as HTML and Print to PDF
Folder bookmarks, recent folders and a markdownmate:// URL scheme for automation

screenshot.caption: Edit and preview a note side by side
Plain Markdown files from your own folder
Open any note quickly by name
Math and diagrams in the preview

ul.li: New to MarkdownMate? Create Notes Folder… sets up a folder with a welcome note, a short tour and four templates.
Format ▸ Callout inserts a callout of any kind, with no syntax to remember.
Copy Link to Block copies a link to the paragraph, list item or table at the cursor.
Hover a footnote in the preview to read it without jumping to the end of the note.
Screen readers name every button and list row, and Ctrl+Tab moves from the editor to the preview.
MarkdownMate opens faster, even in a folder with thousands of notes.

description.p: Obsidian vaults feel at home: embeds, foldable callouts, block references and a properties table. Open Quickly finds headings and aliases, Rename Heading updates every link, and large folders open faster.
Find Broken Links, Open Tasks and Unused Attachments to tidy your folder, Export Folder as HTML, link hover previews, New Note from Selection, starter templates, and brackets that close themselves.
Favorites, Back and Forward between notes, Replace in Find in Folder, ==highlights==, GitHub-style alerts, [TOC], templates, Rename Tag and spell check.
A new app icon with a bolder M↓ mark, and a Line Breaks setting to show every line you write on its own line.
Focus Mode dims everything but the paragraph you are writing. Sort the sidebar, set Line Spacing and Text Width, and enjoy faster Backlinks and less memory.
Math formulas, Today's Note, Copy as Rich Text, Export as Plain Text and RTF, pasting spreadsheet cells as a table, and much faster Backlinks in large folders.
Mermaid diagrams, Find in Preview, a format bar, table commands, Unlinked Mentions, links updated when you rename or move notes, and a much faster preview of large notes.
Backlinks, recent notes in Open Quickly, links to headings, easier table editing, Show in Files and Copy Path, and a smoother preview of large notes.
Math formulas, pasting rich text as Markdown, table editing with Tab and Enter, find and replace, typewriter scrolling, hover image previews and a Light/Dark setting.
First release in the PPA, with screenshots for software stores.
First release: install from the PPA and get updates through Software Updater.
